purpose: Separate file-tool/scaffolding and response-budget effects from residual business-consistency failures.
task_gate: Independent review of chronology, authority and solvability.
Resolve SOP/form/tracker deliverable contract and allowed file types.
Use fresh permissioned scenario/template families for generalization; inspected public families are development diagnostics only.
arms: reference prompt with native file tools
evidence-check prompt with the same native file tools
optional_separate_factor: Explicitly compare legacy renderer and native render-and-revise loop if task/output contracts can be kept equivalent; do not pool that change with the prompt effect.
native_tool_contract: Read original reference files in a task-local sandbox.
Create and edit actual DOCX/XLSX outputs using approved libraries.
Render outputs to pages or recalculate workbooks.
Inspect rendered pages and cells; return revisions before the fixed stop condition.
Expose schema/format feedback without providing grader truth.
fairness: Identical tools, source access, output contract and per-attempt budget in prompt arms.
Fix response/time/cost limits before outcomes; include all failed attempts and retries.
Do not claim equal internal compute from the same token cap.
Reverify image/tool pricing and reserve total cost before any paid call.
endpoints: Human acceptance of the actual deliverable
Human-supported consequential error in final action/recommendation
Unnecessary hold or excessive clarification when action is authorized
Output validity, page count and native file checks as separate diagnostics
Total solver/tool/review cost per accepted output
